sentences.en: I got up at seven o'clock this morning.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上七点起床了。

sentences.en: First, I washed my face and brushed my teeth.
sentences.zh: 首先，我洗了脸、刷了牙。

sentences.en: Then I had bread and milk for breakfast.
sentences.zh: 然后我早餐吃了面包和牛奶。

sentences.en: I put on my shirt and coat and went to school.
sentences.zh: 我穿上衬衫和外套去了学校。

sentences.en: I walked to school with my friend.
sentences.zh: 我和我的朋友一起步行去学校。

sentences.en: We had a test in the morning class.
sentences.zh: 我们上午的课有一个测试。

sentences.en: After school, I went back home.
sentences.zh: 放学后，我回家了。

sentences.en: I did my work for one hour.
sentences.zh: 我做了一个小时的功课。

sentences.en: Then I had dinner with my family.
sentences.zh: 然后我和家人一起吃了晚餐。

sentences.en: I took a bath and went to bed at nine.
sentences.zh: 我洗了澡，九点上了床。

sentences.en: I was very tired after the long day.
sentences.zh: 漫长的一天后我很累。

sentences.en: It was a good day.
sentences.zh: 这是美好的一天。

sentences.en: I was awake when the sun came up.
sentences.zh: 太阳升起时我已经醒了。

sentences.en: I was asleep by ten o'clock.
sentences.zh: 我十点前睡着了。

sentences.en: I put on my sock and shoes before I went out.
sentences.zh: 我出门前穿上袜子和鞋子。

sentences.en: I made a start on my new book.
sentences.zh: 我开始读一本新书。

sentences.en: I took a rest after lunch.
sentences.zh: 午饭后我休息了一会儿。

sentences.en: Every step I took was a step forward.
sentences.zh: 我走的每一步都是向前的一步。

sentences.en: Driving a car is not a simple thing.
sentences.zh: 开车不是一件简单的事。

sentences.en: I have a hearing test at school.
sentences.zh: 我在学校做了听力测试。
